raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “paternal grandmother” as the grandmother of George II (i.e., the mother of George I), incorrectly shifting the target to Christiane Henriette of Palatine Zweibrücken-Birkenfeld. The paternal grandmother of Princess Augusta is her father’s mother—Princess Augusta of Schwarzburg-Sondershausen—not her father’s grandmother. This lineage confusion led to the wrong identification.
